This reconstruction on SWCCGDB (2018) tracks the contemporary Scrye magazine championship lists (Gravity Shadow from [[Jedi Pack]]; Gold Leader In Gold 1 / Red Leader In Red 1 from [[Rebel Leader Packs]]). Starting location is the Scrye-starred site.

The Vermithrax transcription of the Scrye list differs from this SWCCGDB list. Vermithrax has 2 DS-61-4, 2 Gravity Shadow, 2 I Have You Now, 2 Vader's Custom TIE, 5 Sense, 4 Victory-Class Star Destroyer and 1 each of Black 2, Black 3, Black 4, Officer Evax, U-3PO and Vader's Lightsaber, plus Charming To The Last, Imperial-Class Star Destroyer, Labria, Lateral Damage, Nevar Yalnal, TIE Scout, Tonnika Sisters and Undercover, with no Death Star: War Room. Neither list has been checked against the magazine.<ref name="verm">[https://vermsgameblog.blogspot.com/2013/04/star-wars-ccg-1996-dark-side-champion.html Star Wars CCG: 1996 Dark Side Champion Decklists], Vermithrax's Game Blog (7 April 2013; Scrye magazine transcription). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20150729003158/http://vermsgameblog.blogspot.com/2013/04/star-wars-ccg-1996-dark-side-champion.html Internet Archive]</ref>
